summary: The canonical representation is the v1 `semantic-workflow` artifact (packages/workflow-contracts/src/semantic-workflow.ts:9-44): a list of nodes (nodeId, actionType, actionSchemaVersion '1.0.0', CAIP-2 chainId, requiredCapabilities, adapterConstraints{adapters,protocols}, typed `inputs`, `expectedOutputs`, `dependencies`, `userConstraints`, failurePolicy, requiredAuthorizationClass, lockedParameters, editableBounds) plus `resourceEdges` {fromNodeId,outputId,toNodeId,inputName}; it is validated by Ajv + checkWorkflow (schemas.ts:104-178, 311-353), canonicalised and hashed with the frozen DWE-HASH domain framing (canonical.ts:50-81, 127-146, 157-216). Every action kind is a closed declaration: a `createXNode` builds the node and `readXNode` re-creates it from the read fields and refuses any byte difference (swap.ts:67-105, supply.ts:118-145, borrow.ts, repay.ts, withdraw.ts, native-transfer.ts, solana-transfer.ts:34-64, router.ts:41-95, universal-router.ts:67-125, liquidity.ts:47-131, catalog-swap.ts). Amounts in the IR are authored exact native-unit strings (QUANTITY input + a MAXIMUM_INPUT constraint + optional editableBounds); `expectedOutputs.minimumAmount` is hard-coded '0' on every public action (swap.ts:78, router.ts:62, universal-router.ts:91), so the IR carries no estimated/guaranteed/actual triple—expected/minimum/adverse only appear post-quote in QuoteStateArtifact.outputBounds (quote-state.ts:255-260), SimulationBundle.outputs/propagatedOutputs (simulation.ts:15-28) and route models (router.ts:118, universal-router.ts:157), and "actual" only in EvidenceBundle.reconciliation (evidence-bundle.ts:106-112) or the workflow-run StepOutcome.received/spent + BoundResolution{cap,received,used} (apps/reference-dapp/src/workflow-runs/pg-store.ts:21-29). Dependent amounts exist in two unreconciled forms: (1) in the IR, an `OUTPUT_REFERENCE` input + resourceEdge (common.ts:154-158, schemas.ts:127-136), used only by three closed graphs (Base Sepolia lending composition lending-composition.ts:26-31, the registered Solana Devnet Orca swap→liquidity composition-bindings.ts:25-31/67-85, legacy LI.FI bridge→swap and BUILD-011C cross-chain liquidity in reference-linter) and rejected elsewhere (linter SWAP_EDGE_UNSUPPORTED validation.ts:191,200; every runtime `*_ISOLATED_ONLY`, e.g. universal-router.ts:121-125); (2) outside the IR, index-based bindings `{step, amountFrom}` on the v2 step-list StrategySpec (strategy-spec.ts:145-156, workflow-bindings.ts:86-107) resolved at run time as min(cap, reconciled received) (runner.ts:97-122, delegation/executor.ts:455-480), and on the Canvas an implicit funding link derived by exact asset identity between ordered single-node projections (domain/workflow-sequence.ts:94-114, 139-158). Chat/MCP composition (strategy-engine.ts:311-326) turns a StrategySpec into the DApp's own editor Command and runs `editorReducer` from the empty editor so each step is byte-identical to Canvas chat authoring (tested strategy-engine.test.ts:35+, robinhood-composition.test.ts:32-40); but a multi-step v2 workflow is N isolated one-node IRs whose "workflow hash" is a separate sha256 over the ordered step hashes (+bindings) using JSON.stringify (strategy-engine.ts:352-356, 368-389), whereas the Canvas holds one SemanticWorkflow with ordering `dependencies` edges (editor.ts:298-331) hashed by semanticWorkflowHash (strategy-engine.ts:56-58)—so Chat and Canvas do not share one canonical multi-step workflow today. Solana is already in the same node schema (chainId `solana:<genesis>`, native asset {nativeId:'SOL'}): Jupiter swap via createExactInputSwapNode (domain/jupiter-authoring.ts:49), System/SPL transfer (solana-transfer.ts), Orca liquidity (createConcentratedLiquidityNode), and the universal bridge with Solana source or destination (universal-router.ts:67-95, 142-148, 252-266), but the capability registry blocks any multi-node workflow containing a Solana node unless it is the registered Devnet composition (action-registry/src/execution-capabilities.ts:246-250), the ExecutionPlan has only DIRECT_TRANSACTION|SIGNED_INTENT kinds (execution-plan.ts:19-30), and delegated single-authorization refuses Solana and cross-chain bindings (authorization-plan.ts:94-105). The capability catalog is computed, never hand-written: STRATEGY_EXAMPLES are composed through the real reducer and `resolveWorkflowCapability` is run on the resulting IR (capability-catalog.ts:117-133), then certificationMatrix joins flows/web runtimes/ledger evidence (certification-matrix.ts:134-161) and mainnetProductMatrix retires every test-network row (mainnet-product-matrix.ts:26-37); both matrices are committed JSON enforced by tests (certification-matrix.test.ts:206-211, mainnet-product-matrix.test.ts:160-166). Mainnet-only enforcement lives in the public schema branches (strategy-spec.ts:24-30, 165-241), `composeWorkflowOrRefuse`/`validateStrategy` (platform/strategy.ts:31-38, 55-63), domain/network-scope.ts (scopeOfEnv 26-29, introducedTestNetworks 90-94, workflowAllowed 96) and server/network-scope.ts:13-15 (hosted deployments can never opt into ENGINEERING). The compiler consumes one isolated node per artifact chain: read*Node → quote/artifact-set/simulation/policy/manifest/plan (universal-artifacts.ts:38+, crosschain-router.ts:254+, supply.ts:169+, solana-transfer.ts:32-35), with StrategyManifest.executor hard-coded null and enforcement 'NOT_ENFORCED' (manifest.ts:11-20); the delegated path instead compiles per-chain ERC-7710 workflow grants (delegation/workflow-grants.ts:50-53) that the KMS session signer redeems with its own EIP-1559 transactions (delegation/drivers.ts:98-125)—the gas-paying sender PR #166 must retire. Untracked, uncommitted BUILD-…-002 codecs already exist in the working tree (packages/reference-compiler/src/eip5792.ts, erc4337.ts, test/erc4337.test.ts, index.ts:84-85) but nothing in workflow-contracts or the engine references them yet.

(A) The delegated path's gas payer is the KMS session signer: drivers.ts:98-125 builds EIP-1559 `redeemDelegations` transactions from ctx.grant.sessionAddress with its own nonce/gas; authorization-plan.ts:110 states only that 'every step … pays its own network fees' without saying who; there is no IR/plan field or test asserting the owner account is the sender. The new eip5792.ts/erc4337.ts codecs (untracked) are not yet wired into capabilities.ts MECHANISMS (15), authorizationPlan modes (authorization-plan.ts:33-48) or RUN_MODES (state-machine.ts:21-22).

(A/honesty) certification-matrix OTHER_ROWS 'sequence-delegated-single-authorization' still says 'Production has no delegated signer provider (KMS/HSM)' (certification-matrix.ts:124-127) although the AWS KMS executor signer landed (git cd7508d, PR #163/#166); 'bridge-evm-solana' claims BRIDGE_ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE (128-131) although the universal router registers Solana mainnet rows (execution-capabilities.ts:155-156) and composes EVM→Solana (universal-bridge.test.ts:30-35). Both committed matrix JSONs will need regeneration.

(B) No single canonical multi-step workflow shared by Chat and Canvas: composeWorkflow yields N isolated single-node IRs plus a separate sequence hash computed with JSON.stringify over step hashes + bindings (strategy-engine.ts:352-356, 368-389), while the Canvas holds one SemanticWorkflow with ordering `dependencies` (editor.ts:326) hashed by semanticWorkflowHash (56-58) and derives funding implicitly by asset identity (workflow-sequence.ts:103-109); the two are bridged only by per-step projections (workflow-sequence.ts:82-84) and compositionWorkflow() excludes any workflow with resourceEdges from the sequence path (86-89). A given multi-step graph therefore has different hashes and binding semantics in Chat vs Canvas.

(B) IR-level dependent amounts (OUTPUT_REFERENCE + resourceEdges) are accepted by the schema (schemas.ts:127-136) but rejected for every public action: linter SWAP_EDGE_UNSUPPORTED on any edge touching a swap or liquidity node (validation.ts:191, 200), draft validation allows a typed link only for a registered bound composition (workflow-draft.ts:25-27), the registry has exactly one composition (Solana Devnet Orca, composition-bindings.ts:31) and every compiler/linter enforces `*_ISOLATED_ONLY` (universal-router.ts:121-125, reference-linter crosschain-router.ts:10, borrow.ts:189, supply.ts:175, native-transfer.ts:97, solana-transfer.ts:35, cow.ts:116). The only multi-node graphs with typed edges are test-network or legacy (lending-composition Base Sepolia, LI.FI bridge→swap Base→Arbitrum linter bridge-swap.ts, BUILD-011C cross-chain liquidity).

(B) No `previous.output.amount`-style expression: bindings are positional {step, amountFrom} (strategy-spec.ts:145-149) resolved at execution to min(cap, received) (workflow-bindings.ts:113-117); there is no estimated/guaranteed/actual triple on a step — only string codes RECONCILED_RECEIVED_AMOUNT vs SIGNED_GUARANTEED_MINIMUM in the authorization plan (authorization-plan.ts:44-46) — and expectedOutputs.minimumAmount is always '0' (swap.ts:78, router.ts:62, universal-router.ts:91) so the simulation's propagatedOutputs are empty for every public chain (crosschain-router.ts:297; universal-artifacts similar).

(B) Cross-chain dependent amounts: a bridge producer binds only through asset-out on the destination chain by exact identity (workflow-bindings.ts:41, 75-78, 98); the run resolves received from producer.outcome.received (runner.ts:104-105) and the Canvas from deliveredByRecord 'universal'/'router' verdict RECONCILED (workflow-sequence.ts:205-213) — two separate 'actual' readers; delegated mode refuses any cross-chain binding (authorization-plan.ts:94-97, 105 WORKFLOW_BINDING_NOT_EXACT; workflow-grants.ts:12-14), and chat observation of settlement (workflow-runs/observe.ts) was not read.

(B) Percentage / remaining-balance bindings do not exist: ParameterSchema (common.ts:123-159) and ConstraintSchema (166-179) have no fractional or balance kinds; StrategySpec amounts are absolute decimals (strategy-spec.ts:37); withdraw/repay refuse MAX-uint 'all' semantics (withdraw.ts:71, repay.ts:92); the Copilot's 'remaining tokens' resolves to an absolute amount from a reconciled execution before authoring (domain/copilot-conversation.ts:1021-1035) — grep found no percentage/remaining concept in workflow-contracts, engine or workflow-runs.

(B) Solana in the same IR is representable but not composable: resolveWorkflowCapability adds COMPOSITION_UNSUPPORTED to any workflow with >1 financial node that contains a Solana node unless it is the registered Devnet composition (execution-capabilities.ts:246-250); Solana swaps in StrategySpec are limited to enumerated symbols (strategy-engine.ts:234-237 'as never'); Orca liquidity cannot be previewed server-side (mcp/simulation.ts:61); delegation refuses Solana (capabilities.ts:74-79; authorization-plan.ts:98, 105); ExecutionPlan has no Solana execution kind and universal-artifacts hashes a Solana message as a DIRECT_TRANSACTION payload (universal-artifacts.ts:47).

(B) Chat/Canvas parity gaps: the v2 step list collapses supply→borrow→swap into lending_composition only on Base Sepolia (strategy-engine.ts:359-367), which the public product does not offer (strategy-spec.ts:29-30), so no mainnet lending composition exists; Canvas multi-step runs require each one-node projection to pass the linter alone (workflow-sequence.ts:100) and exclude positions/Solana composition runtimes from sequences (119).

(C) Interaction counting is coarse and partly unknown: confirmEachStep.walletConfirmationsAtLeast = steps.length (authorization-plan.ts:116) ignores per-flow approvals; delegated walletSignatures = max(1, EVM chains) with a one-time EIP-7702 enrollment whose `active` is null until signing (88-91, 117); there is no count for ERC-20 approvals, EIP-7702 authorization transactions, Solana signAll groups or per-chain batches, no per-chain execution group in the chat ExecutionPlan (mcp/execution.ts:95-97), and the v1 artifact's per-chain segments (execution-plan.ts:22-29) are not produced for sequences.

(C) No 'collect every authorization upfront' model: the runner advances step k only after step k−1 is RECONCILED (runner.ts:93) and each step is re-composed/re-gated then (126-130); grants are per EVM chain only (workflow-grants.ts:3-6); Solana never participates (authorization-plan.ts:98).
